import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int countTime(String time){String[] p=time.split(":");int h=0,m=0;for(int i=0;i<24;i++){String s=String.format("%02d",i);if((p[0].charAt(0)=='?'||p[0].charAt(0)==s.charAt(0))&&(p[0].charAt(1)=='?'||p[0].charAt(1)==s.charAt(1)))h++;}for(int i=0;i<60;i++){String s=String.format("%02d",i);if((p[1].charAt(0)=='?'||p[1].charAt(0)==s.charAt(0))&&(p[1].charAt(1)=='?'||p[1].charAt(1)==s.charAt(1)))m++;}return h*m;} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String oddString(String[] words){Map<String,Integer> f=new HashMap<>();for(String w:words)f.merge(sig(w),1,Integer::sum);for(String w:words)if(f.get(sig(w))==1)return w;return "";} private String sig(String w){StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();for(int i=1;i<w.length();i++)b.append((int)w.charAt(i)-(int)w.charAt(i-1)).append(',');return b.toString();} }
